page.overview:
Who is Frostbite?

One Christmas Eve Frostbite and Footloose were stationed in the Norwegian Arctic Circle where they prevented a squad of Snow Serpents from destroying the base. At a Christmas meal around a campfire, the only food coming in bar form, Frostbite revealed he didn't like the turkey, stuffing and brussel sprouts bar but ate up because plum pudding was coming. Later Frostbite and Iceberg were stationed at the Apogee Base in Greenland when it was attacked by Destro and a squad of F.A.N.G.s. The attack was fought off and Frostbite remained at the base whilst Iceberg and Flint pursued Destro. Frostbite subsequently became part of Tiger Force and was present for an early mission to Jordan to destroy a shot down Phantom X-19 and rescue Ghostrider and Scarlett.

{| class="wikitable" style="border-collapse:collapse;" ! colspan="2" style="border:1px solid black" |Generation 1

Frostbite was released as part of the 1985 series of the Real American Hero toys, packaged exclusively with the Snow Cat arctic assault half-track vehicle. ---- Appearance: beige fur cap with black goggles; black hair and beard; white coat with white gloves, black holster, and beige fur collar; white pants and boots with black belt and boots.

Accessories: oversized black M-16 with large scope. ---- [http://www.yojoe.com/action/85/frostbite.shtml YoJoe.com page]/[http://www.yojoe.com/filecard/85/frostbite.shtml Filecard]
